names: UCSF Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure
summary: UCSF's nine-level Building 23B Parking Structure at 1650 3rd Street in Mission Bay, on Block 23 between 3rd and 4th Streets: a $23.3M budget was submitted to the Regents in November 2003 for approval, with construction slated to run March 2004 to July 2005 (no source read reports the actual dates). Designed by Stanley Saitowitz/Natoma Architects; its original channel-glass facade was removed in 2015 and IwamotoScott's 'Cellular Origami' facade of white anodized metal panels was completed in January 2020 (Facades+, March 2021). The contractor's page gives 882 parking stalls; the 2003 budget item gave 822 spaces.

milestones.text: UC Regents' Committee on Grounds and Buildings and Committee on Finance are asked to approve a $23,298,000 budget, to be funded from external financing, for the Mission Bay Building 23B Parking Structure Project (822 spaces on nine levels plus 52 surface spaces, Block 23); the item, dated November 6, 2003, requests approval and does not record the vote; it says construction is slated to begin in March 2004 and to be completed by July 2005

Original channel-glass facade removed from the garage, 'leaving the building barren with worn and exposed concrete' (Facades+, March 15, 2021), so the garage was standing by 2015; no source read reports when it was first completed

IwamotoScott's 'Cellular Origami' facade of white anodized metal panels is completed on the garage (Facades+, March 15, 2021: 'Completion Date: January 2020'), replacing the original channel-glass facade, which the same article says was removed in 2015

open_questions: No source confirms the garage's actual completion date; the 2005-07 milestone above is the 2003 budget item's projected schedule, not a completion announcement -- a UC construction schedule commonly slips, so this date is flagged approximate.

The 2003 Regents item describes a nine-level, 822-space structure; this record's map data cites OpenStreetMap tagging of 8 levels -- not reconciled here, since OSM levels and the Regents' 'nine levels (including a half level at the top)' description are plausibly the same building described two ways. The building's own general contractor (Overaa, added 2026-09-22) separately gives 882 stalls -- likely the as-built figure versus the Regents' pre-construction budget estimate, but not reconciled here either.
Exact capacity today (after any reconfiguration) is not confirmed by any source found, per this record's map notes.
The general contractor for the original 2004-2005 construction was not identified as of 2026-09-22.

As of 2026-09-29: the earlier '2021 facade replacement' was wrong: Facades+ (March 15, 2021) gives the completion date as January 2020 and says the channel-glass facade was removed in 2015; The Architect's Newspaper article cited before could not be read. The November 2003 Regents item is a request for approval; the committee minutes recording the vote were not found (no 2003 minutes page could be located online).

Corrected 2026-10-06 (accuracy audit, October 2026): the March 2004 construction start and July 2005 completion projected in the November 2003 Regents item were shown as expected milestones (the completion with status complete), two decades past and unconfirmed. Both were removed; the projection is now stated in the budget-item milestone, and the earliest sourced evidence that the garage stood is Facades+'s report that its original facade was removed in 2015. The actual construction start and completion dates are still unknown.
